svg.title: NumPilot architecture
svg.desc: An unclassified NumPy workload is inventoried before per-call AsNumpy capability checks and a fail-closed whole-workload decision, including CAPABILITY_AUDIT_REQUIRED when runtime evidence is incomplete. Eligible workloads proceed to whole-file migration and verification. A confirmed gap follows either Huawei official-operator reuse or, after two clean official misses, a CANNBot-Skills-guided configured-model custom-operator draft; both routes converge on AsNumpy integration, qualification, activation, and workload rescan. Solid paths are current primitives and dashed paths are target automation. Current boundaries are installed binary CANDIDATE_READY, reviewed MatMul ADAPTER_CANDIDATE with REVIEWED_MATMUL_ONLY scope, pinned ops-nn SOURCE_EVIDENCE_ONLY, and CANNBot plus model UNVERIFIED_OPERATOR_DRAFT. CodeArts is an optional coordination plane, not a runtime dependency.
